added.summary: A converted Effekseer one-shot effect (by `og vfx import` or by the cook, from an `.efkproj` or `.efkefc` in assets/) now has an `impact`: the frame in its first 60% where the most is added to the picture at once, so it sends og.VfxEvent `impact` where it hits. `og vfx import --hit` also adds a light in the colour of what starts there and a camera shake by its size. Looping effects get neither.
